stem:
Two waves, each with a constant amplitude, interfere and produce an interference pattern. The
pattern has minima at fixed points where the displacement is zero at all times.

options.B: They must be coherent but not necessarily of the same amplitude.
options.C: They must be of the same amplitude but not necessarily coherent.
options.D: They must not be coherent or of the same amplitude.
